posts.text: Could you tell me which Zemismart switch models each of these corresponds to? For example, the 606 series, 808 series, ZMS-206, etc. thanks in advance.

hanks for forwarding it! The switches I’ve been testing correspond to the TB25 series — TB25-1, TB25-2, TB25-3, TB25-4 and TB25-6 (1 to 6 gang), plus a 4-gang ZCL variant and a touch model. The touch model actually uses the exact same driver code as the others — I only split it into a separate driver because of its icon/artwork file, not because of any functional difference. That said, the code isn’t tied to exact model numbers — any device sharing the same clusters and functions should work with it as-is. To be clear about scope, my driver goes well beyond basic on/off: Shows sibling gangs in the device’s advanced settings — which one is the main device and which are the linked sub-devices, with the placeholder “connected switches” text replaced live by whatever name the user gave each device. Switch mode and backlight are only configurable from the main device, since they’re shared settings across the whole switch. Detects network rejoin after a power loss Re-applies backlight state at that moment, if the user prefers it off Configures pulse/inching mode Reports network activity — message count in the last hour and last 24h, plus which device is sending the most messages (stats)

Hi VicHY — thanks for the detailed report, that helped a lot. I found the cause on the clrdrnya mmWave radars. After an app update, some radar setting DPs (sensitivity, range, delay) were being restored as curtain/blind capabilities from stored data. That’s the “blind mode” UI, and one of those DPs was also feeding motion, which explains the stuck presence. Delete + re-pair works until the next update because it clears that stored state temporarily. Fix is in Test 9.0.790+: phantom caps are stripped automatically and DynCap no longer re-applies them on update. Please update, restart the app, and check both sensors. Re-pair only if they still show as blinds. The “flooding the Zigbee network” timeline message is the app rate-limiting ~200 msg/min from the Tuya firmware — related to the stuck presence spam, and it should calm down once the sensor is healed. Let me know if it persists after 9.0.790.
